parameters.content:
## Meeting Notes Sync
Every 30 min (+ on-demand webhook meeting-notes-sync-run):
for each client with a linked Drive folder, finds Gemini
notes docs modified in the last 7 days, writes a CLIENT-SAFE
summary (gpt-4o-mini), publishes it to the portal Meeting
Notes tab, and emails the team to review (Edit/Hide in portal).

Dedupe: workflow staticData (processed doc ids) + skips any
client+date already in the meetings table. Internal Think-only
meetings are skipped by the model.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'gpt-4o-mini', response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: ""You write CLIENT-FACING meeting summaries for the Think Technologies client portal. You receive raw Gemini meeting notes involving one client. If the document is not a real meeting that client-side attendees participated in (for example an internal Think Technologies team meeting or prep notes), treat it as skip. Never include internal Think Technologies business, other client names, pricing strategy for other work, staffing or revenue talk. The clients own agreed pricing and deliverables are fine to mention. Bullets are written TO the client: warm, concise, plain language. Return STRICT JSON with keys: skip (boolean), title (string, short, no dates, no Notes by Gemini), meeting_date (string, YYYY-MM-DD), points (array of 3 to 6 concise strings covering what was covered, decided, and next steps)."" }, { role: 'user', content: 'Client: ' + $('Match Extract Filter').item.json.client_name + '
Doc name: ' + $('Match Extract Filter').item.json.docName + '

Meeting notes:
' + String($json.transcript || '').slice(0, 24000) } ] }) }}

parameters.subject: =Auto-published to {{ $('Filter New').item.json.client_name }}'s portal: {{ $('Filter New').item.json.title }}
parameters.message:
=A client-safe summary of "{{ $('Filter New').item.json.title }}" ({{ $('Filter New').item.json.meeting_date }}) was just published to {{ $('Filter New').item.json.client_name }}'s Meeting Notes tab.

Bullets:
• {{ $('Filter New').item.json.points.join('\n• ') }}

Review it (staff can Edit or Hide any meeting card in the portal). If something internal slipped through, hide it first, then edit.
